items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: He says well Clark, you know, and Johnny Bunch and Bob Haggart, Kenny Davern and Dan Barrett. Wow.

ctx.x: Well he put in a year last year, from the looks of his schedule doing his 75th birthday tour, that would have taxed anybody.

Well you want to know something? If he hadn’t done it, he would have melted. My wife gets mad at me sometimes because I take jobs. And I know she realizes I do it because I want to play, I love to play. I can’t believe people pay me large sums of money for doing simply what I love to do. And the first question I ask is who am I fighting? Who am I playing with? And when I got called to do this, you know Milt Fillius called me and he told me, “I’d like you to do this thing at the school, up at the college,” and I’d…
